description: On the counter in front of you there’s an open cardboard box with a clear plastic container inside, a black-and-yellow tape measure, and a small white drawer unit with a clear front bin holding a red tape dispenser and a roll of tape. The left hand stays near the box while the right hand reaches to the clear bin, grasps the tape dispenser with the tape roll (right-hand object), lifts it up and left, then lowers it into the open cardboard box and releases it.
